mentions.name: Hyperplane Eval
mentions.description: Hyperplane Eval is a local property-based testing tool for AI agents that automatically discovers behavioral failure regions in agent behavior instead of relying on manually written prompts.
mentions.problem: Testing AI agents via manually written prompts misses behavioral failure regions, which the tool discovers automatically.
